name: zclass_camera_build_world_transform
description: zClass_Camera::BuildWorldTransform builds the camera world matrix, applies an optional position offset, caches camera position, forward direction, Euler angles, staged camera inverse rotation, and optional listener state.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this camera transform helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass camera/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44abf0 validates MatLoadIdentity, gwNode::BuildNodeToAncestorMatrix(camera, 1), optional position-offset addition, cameraPos copy, forwardDir from negated matrix z-axis, worldTransform copy, Euler extraction, camera inverse-rotation staging, optional sound-listener velocity clamp/update path, and zero return.
The native camera smoke verifies the no-listener path with local camera translation, explicit position offset, camera position, forward direction, and world-transform cache writes.
